faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before signing up.
faq.a1: During signup, you capture a live selfie that we compare against your profile photos. Only verified members can browse or message â€” no bots, no catfishing, no second accounts.
faq.q2: Why is toNikah a paid-only community?
faq.a2: A small membership fee filters out curiosity signups and keeps the community focused on Nikah. Everyone you meet has committed something real to be here â€” that changes the conversations.
faq.q3: How is this different from dating apps?
faq.a3: No swiping. No popularity scores. No matching gates. You browse every profile, send one respectful intro per person, and if they reply, the conversation begins. Built for Nikah, not entertainment.
faq.a4: You control per-person visibility. Grant access to specific people, set a time window, or revoke at any moment. Your private gallery stays private until you decide otherwise.
faq.a5: Yes. You can nominate a wali or family reference on your profile, and members can contact them directly â€” keeping the process transparent and in line with Islamic tradition.
faq.q6: What if the person doesn't reply?
faq.a6: That's okay â€” intent matters both ways. Their profile returns to your browse list, and you can focus on others. No badges, no penalties, no pressure.

testimonials.title: Real people. Real intent.
testimonials.t1: Finally a platform that respects the intent of Nikah. The selfie verification and no-swipe system made me feel safe from day one.
testimonials.t2: One intro message per profile forces you to be thoughtful. No swiping fatigue, no popularity contests â€” just real people with real intent.
testimonials.t3: The private gallery control is brilliant â€” I decide who sees my photos and for how long. That kind of respect for privacy is rare.
testimonials.t4: A paid-only community keeps it serious. Everyone here is ready for Nikah, not timepass. The price is more than fair.
